faq-1.question: What is the INSTAT platform?
faq-1.answer: INSTAT is the Institute for Professional Development and Statistical Research under the Statistics Agency of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan. The platform brings together online courses, an e-library and statistical data.

faq-2.question: What courses are available on the platform?
faq-2.answer: Courses cover the system of national accounts, statistical methodology, industrial statistics, gender statistics, investment statistics and many other areas — for both beginner and professional levels.

faq-3.question: How do I enrol in a course?
faq-3.answer: To register, click “Sign up”, enter your details and confirm your email. After that you can enrol in any course.

faq-4.question: Are the courses paid or free?
faq-4.answer: The platform's core courses are free. Some specialised courses and certification programmes may be paid; prices are shown on each course page.

faq-5.question: How do I use the e-library?
faq-5.answer: Once registered, you gain access to more than 50,000 books and research materials in the e-library. Books can be read online or downloaded.

faq-6.question: Are there mobile apps?
faq-6.answer: Yes, INSTAT has mobile apps for iOS and Android. Download them from Google Play or the App Store and access all course materials from your device.

faq-7.question: Is a certificate issued?
faq-7.answer: Participants who complete a course receive an official certificate. It is issued electronically and can be verified through the link provided.

faq-8.question: Where do I go with further questions?
faq-8.answer: You can reach us at info@instat.uz or by phone at (+998 71) 202-11-10. Working hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00–18:00.

article-requirements-1.title: Follow the standard structure
article-requirements-1.desc: The article must be 2,500–3,000 words and include the sections: Introduction, Literature review, Research methodology, Analysis and results, Conclusions and recommendations.

article-requirements-2.title: A UDC code is mandatory
article-requirements-2.desc: Every article must be assigned a UDC code (via udc.online). The title must be precise, academic and fully reflect the content.

article-requirements-3.title: Complete author details
article-requirements-3.desc: Full name, academic degree, position, organisation, city/country, email and phone number must be given in the language of the main text.

article-requirements-4.title: Abstract in three languages
article-requirements-4.desc: The abstract must be provided in Uzbek, Russian and English (250–300 words). Provide 15–20 keywords in Uzbek and English.

article-requirements-5.title: Results and conclusions must be substantiated
article-requirements-5.desc: Methods must be described precisely enough to be reproducible, results must be evidence-based, and the conclusion must offer clear scientific findings and practical recommendations.
